calculation.title: Bundle Pricing & Unit Economics: The Royal Festive Bridal Ensemble
calculation.methodology: Empirical Market Basket Apriori Mining & Margin Floor Preservation

pricingModel.formula: Bundle Price = Sum(Individual MRPs) × (1 - Bundle Discount %)
pricingModel.derivation: Combined items MRP: ₹10,697. Applied incentive discount of 15% (-₹1,608). Final smart bundle price: ₹9,089.

marginModel.formula: Preserved Gross Profit = Bundle Price - Combined Wholesale Unit Costs (58% MRP)
marginModel.derivation: Retail Price: ₹9,089 - Wholesale Cost: ₹6,203 = ₹2,886 gross margin (31.8% margin retained, strictly preserving the ≥25.0% floor).

aovModel.formula: AOV Uplift = (Bundle Price - Baseline Store AOV) / Baseline Store AOV
aovModel.derivation: (₹9,089 bundle price - ₹5,144 store AOV) / ₹5,144 = +77% AOV expansion per bundle transaction.
